adaptation.trainable: BN1d/BN2d affine scale and bias only; LN frozen

permissions.source_labels: not used for adaptation; source/valid inputs only for existing split verification

decision.primary: paired Macro-F1/NAR/recovery versus bn_batchstats_no_update; frozen and no_pseudo_fixed descriptive references
decision.report: all seeds/dates; negative, neutral and positive outcomes; do not presume collapse
decision.collapse_diagnostic: report finite logits, predicted unique classes and max predicted-class fraction; no query-based tuning
decision.selection: no tuning; terminal step800; no early stopping based on labels

evaluation.protocol: support gradient adaptation then terminal query; explicit batch-stat transductive forward only
evaluation.query_order: existing query index order; no shuffle
evaluation.model_mode: eval disables dropout; BN still uses current query batch because buffers=None
evaluation.control: source weights with same BN batch-stat configuration, no optimizer updates
evaluation.caveat: TENT mechanism port, not official online same-query forward-update protocol; reference no_pseudo_fixed uses tracked BN stats; cross-protocol differences reported

repair_reason: preflight smoke test legitimately created artifacts/events.jsonl; v2 uses launch.json plus runner_started.json as startup guard and permits preflight events.
